name: routing-pane-adds-a-rule
description: A route created in the Routing pane is honoured by route_for_url on the next matching navigation - no relaunch. Home (oceanBlue) starts active with Work (sunsetOrange) as its sibling, same profile so the reroute stays a plain SelectSpace rather than a cross-profile reopen. The routing fixture stages an EMPTY rule list, so file_contains has a baseline the added rule cannot already match. The pane is driven through eval on /settings - .engine-add, then the pattern field's blur commit, then the target-space select's change commit - the same two-commit shape settings-confirm-quit-toggle.json uses for its toggle, because the row cannot validate matchType+pattern+targetSpaceID in one write from an Add click alone. A typed URL in the command bar is the real navigation: AtriumRoutingNavigationThrottle sits on WillStartRequest for every tab, not only command-bar ones, so this is the same trigger search-engines-tab-to-youtube.json uses, not a special path.

actions.note: gate: the Home tab committed, so the app and profile are live
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
Home tint (oceanBlue) baseline
open the settings window
let PushSettings and PushRouting's thread-pool reads land
the pane's data source loaded - the list has something to be empty FROM

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="routing"]'); if (!item) { return 'no routing rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: The pane lists the rules the store holds - zero, from the empty staged file

actions.expression: (() => { const add = document.querySelector('.engine-add'); if (!add) { return 'no engine-add button'; } add.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
actions.note: The add control this pane previously had none of

actions.expression: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('.engine-detail input[name="pattern"]'); if (!input) { return 'no pattern field'; } input.value = 'corp.example'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', {bubbles: true})); return 'committed'; })()
actions.note: matchType defaults to contains and targetSpaceID defaults to the first space, so this alone validates and sends
Write half: the pattern-only commit reached the core
let the write's reply repaint the detail panel with the saved rule

actions.expression: (() => { const select = document.querySelector('.engine-detail select[name="targetSpaceID"]'); if (!select) { return 'no target select'; } select.value = '437a0002-0000-4000-8000-00000000ad02'; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); return 'committed'; })()
actions.note: The add control creates a rule with its match type, pattern AND target space - this is the third field
the second write's round trip
closes the key Settings window - cmd+t opens a tab in the KEY window, and Settings does not have one
let the close finish and key status pass to the browser window
open the command bar for a REAL navigation, not a store read
a URL whose host matches the rule just saved
commit the typed URL - the navigation the throttle sees
route_for_url honoured the rule on this navigation, in the SAME run the rule was saved in - no relaunch
let the space switch and repaint settle
should now show Work tint (sunsetOrange)
